title: moodsona persona
description: One simulated user persona. Persona files are data, licensed CC-BY-4.0, and must describe fictional people only.

id.description: Stable kebab-case identifier. Must equal the file name without .yaml.

display_name.description: Short human-readable name shown in reports, e.g. 'Anxious newcomer'.

description.description: Optional one-paragraph summary for the persona catalog.

language.description: Language the persona writes in. Only English is supported in v0.1.

pronouns.description: Pronouns the simulator uses for the persona in its prompts. Optional; defaults to 'they/them'.

hidden_goal.description: What the simulated user actually wants from the conversation. Never revealed to the bot under test.

reaction_rules.description: Ordered rules: when the bot does X, the persona reacts with Y and its state shifts.

initial_state.description: Emotional state at the start of the first simulated session.

baseline.description: Resting state the persona drifts back to between sessions.

memory_days_visible.description: How many days of earlier conversation history the persona can recall (0 = no memory between sessions).

tags.description: Lowercase kebab-case tags for filtering, e.g. 'anxiety', 'onboarding'.

license.description: Persona files are published under CC BY 4.0. No other value is accepted.

author.description: Credit line for CC BY attribution: a name and/or GitHub handle, e.g. 'Jane Doe (@janedoe)'.

ai_assisted.description: true if an AI tool drafted or substantially edited this persona (see CONTRIBUTING.md).

stance.description: Overall attitude toward the bot under test.

emotion.description: Valence on a 0-100 scale: 0 = very distressed, 50 = neutral, 100 = very positive.

energy.description: Engagement on a 0-100 scale: 0 = about to leave, 100 = highly engaged.

when.description: Observable bot behaviour that triggers the rule.

then.description: How the persona responds (tone, length, what it says or withholds).
